about: Model-provider confinement falsifiers (cc-model-confine lane, task 006). Every entry edits capsules/model-provider/confine.sb, which sandbox-exec reads at each launch, so a mutated profile needs no rebuild. F-cc1a turns (deny default) into (allow default) and F-cc1b widens the journal read/write grant from STORAGE_ROOT to STORAGE_PARENT; model_outside_write_denied then fails because the redirected journal write succeeds. Each F-cc1-rm entry removes one allow rule and model_provider_ops_under_profile fails. The (deny network*) rule is held by the shared contract check in the wallet crate, which a provider-command list cannot run. The confined tests need /usr/bin/sandbox-exec and skip without it, so this list is a Mac gate. Files are relative to examples/agent-host.

falsifiers.title: the profile allows every operation by default
the journal read/write grant covers STORAGE_PARENT instead of STORAGE_ROOT
the profile no longer lets the provider binary execute
the profile no longer lets startup read the root directory
the profile no longer lets startup read kernel facts
the profile no longer lets init inspect STORAGE_PARENT
the profile no longer grants read/write under STORAGE_ROOT
